quality_check.description: A single vertical atlas-card composition shows a stark black swan near the top as the endpoint of a completed, thick, jagged soot-black route. A restrained vermilion burst marks the final arrival beneath the swan. Numerous black arrows, thin construction lines, geometric guides, and muted blue-gray structural accents overlay a broad pale field. The image uses coarse screen-print grain, flat ink shapes, worn edges, an imperfect dark outer border, narrow bone-white margin, and an inset illustration window. The lower portion contains diagrammatic architectural or city-like blocks and rails rather than remaining purely tabletop-like.
violations: The retroactive drawing action is not fully explicit: arrows and technical lines are visible, but they read as already completed marks rather than clearly distinguishable structure being added backward after the swan event.

The contrast between the genuinely irregular route and the newly imposed tidy logical structure is weaker than requested because many construction lines and arrows are themselves tangled, intersecting, and visually chaotic.
Arrow directions are mixed across the scene, so the intended backward explanatory movement from the swan endpoint is not immediately legible.
The lower third introduces architectural or city-like blocks, window grids, and rail-like structures, weakening the requested tabletop-like pale stone field.
The imposed explanatory geometry does not consistently appear more precise or orderly than the irregular black path, reducing the intended clean-versus-messy conceptual contrast.

Make the contrast between the genuinely irregular path and the newly imposed tidy structure immediately legible. Use dry matte screen-print ink, coarse archival grain, slight registration wear, bold flat soot-black forms, muted storm blue-gray and oxidized teal, broad matte light fields, deep graphic ink shadows, and occasional dry-ink breaks. Preserve the recurring vertical atlas-card frame: thick imperfect soot-black outer print edge, narrow bone-white margin, inset rectangular illustration window, tiny registration offsets, worn corners. Fill the full illustration height naturally; no lower caption reserve, blank strip, empty panel, or artificial low-detail band. The previous_beat is binding for frame material and edges, inner-window treatment, texture, palette, and lighting, but do not copy its composition, crop, camera arrangement, subject placement, or focal object. No host or recurring character. No photorealism, glossy CGI, anime, watercolor, sepia engraving, cyberpunk neon, readable charts, UI, captions, labels, letters, numbers, or any readable text.

Diagrams, environments, swans, tools, markets, and technology scenes all remain inside this repeated print-window grammar, with the border thickness and inner margins held consistent throughout the episode. Preserve its material/edge grammar, texture, palette and inner illustration window while changing only the scene inside it.
